title: Raj Ayush UG/PG Counselling Board
raw_text: Raj Ayush UG/PG Counselling Board OFFICE OF CHAIRMAN, COUNSELING BOARD (UG/PG AYUSH Counseling Board, Govt. of Rajasthan) 212-214 AYUSH BHAWAN Sector-26 Pratap Nagar, Jaipur 302033 Toggle navigation Read Instructions Home Contact Us Counselling Information List of In-eligible candidates to participate in Central/State /UT/ Central Pool Quota of Ayush Counseling for admission to ASU & H UG-courses for the A.Y 2026-27 Provisional Seat Allocation List (Counselling, Round 3) for BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BNYS Admissions – 2026-27 (As on dated: 29.10.2026) TENTATIVE REVISED VACANT SEAT MATRIX FOR 3rd ROUND AIQ QUOTA (Private), STATE QUOTA ( Govt. & Private) & NRI QUOTA (Private) SESSION 2026-27 as on 28.10.2026 Tentative BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BNYS Counselling Schedule for State Quota & NRI Quota for session 2026-27 3rd Round Schedule (Revised) 27.10.2026 Kind Attention to all candidates participating in Round3 of Counseling-2026 Fee Structure of Participating Institutes INFORMATION BOOKLET BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BNYS ADMISSION COUNSELLING-2026-27 Our Gallery Welcome to Rajasthan Neet Ayush UG / PG Counselling Board - 2026 Click here for Counselling 2026-27 For Admission in AYUSH Under Graduate Courses viz. BAMS, BHMS BUMS & BNYS through NEET-2026 and AYUSH PG Courses (M.D./M.S.) (Ayurved) & M.D. (Homoeopathy) in AYUSH educational institutions in Rajasthan on state quota seats and NRI seats for the Session 2026-27, a State level Counseling Board has been constituted by the Government of Rajasthan under the Chairmanship of Dr. Batti Lal Bairwa, Additional Director, Department of Ayurveda, Govt of Rajasthan, Wide Order No. प. 25 (7) आयु./ 2023-1291 dated 26 July 2024. Aspirants will be required to get registered themselves for admission counseling for the Session 2026-27 in AYUSH colleges located in Rajasthan on the website of Counseling Board on the Dates as per Schedule after declaration of result of NEET-2026. Best Wishes Dr. Batti Lal Bairwa Chairman Latest News & Events List of In-eligible candidates to participate in Central/State /UT/ Central Pool Quota of Ayush Counseling for admission to ASU & H UG-courses for the A.Y 2026-27 Grievances sent only from the registered email address will be taken into consideration.
